benefits.name: Homestead Exemption
benefits.description: A library benefit for Philadelphia homeowners. Open its checks to see how residence, ownership, tax abatement, and existing enrollment combine. The enrollment check has a benefit parameter; the same reusable check is configured differently for each tax program.

benefits.name: Owner-Occupied Payment Agreement (OOPA)
benefits.description: A library benefit for homeowners with delinquent property taxes. Compare its checks with Homestead: both reuse residence and ownership, while OOPA adds tax delinquency. Change one answer in Preview to see several benefits update together.

benefits.name: Philly Cash (fictional)
benefits.description: A made-up benefit: you qualify if you live in Philadelphia, would like extra cash, and your household earns $40,000 a year or less. Its two custom checks show different kinds of logic: Would like extra cash compares a Yes/No answer, while Household income limit compares a number with an incomeLimit parameter that this benefit sets to 40000. Open Custom Checks to inspect their annotated diagrams, edit the logic, test it, and publish a new version. Both are pinned to published version 1.0.0. This program does not exist and pays no money.

benefits.name: Senior Citizen Tax Freeze (SCTF)
benefits.description: A library benefit illustrating age logic for an applicant, spouse, or late spouse. Try an applicant over 65, then a younger applicant with a spouse over 65. An unanswered birth date can produce Unable to determine. These are the current library rules; this example does not add income criteria.
